title: Optimizing UV-C irradiation for microbial safety and quality of Kinnow fruit juice

The study analyzed UV-C irradiation as a non-thermal preservation method for Kinnow fruit juice (KFJ), aiming to reduce microbial contamination while preserving vitamin C content.
